rules: Never reset to idle between clips: blend from the end pose into the next clip/state over blend_frames.
Grounded end poses (prone, prone_ball, kneel_carry) only go to grounded states or BS215; never straight back to sprint.

MASS:<id> means the existing tackle pair with that id (runner clip). sprint_carry = the exact runner start pose of those pairs (right-arm carry); use the _mirror tackle clips for left-arm carry clips.
example_chains: SPRINT -> BS053 single bobble -> secured -> sprint_carry
SPRINT -> BS054 single bobble -> incomplete -> jog
SPRINT -> BS079 failed dive -> prone -> BS215 get up
JOG -> BS085 jump -> land_carry -> BS092 style recovery
SPRINT -> BS101..BS113 contested -> defender swat -> BS216 recover
catch (sprint_carry_brace, BS192) -> MASS S11 side wrap
catch (brace_carry, BS193) -> MASS F21 front wrap
BS133 interception -> turn upfield -> sprint_carry return
BS139 release -> BS143 decelerate -> BS144/BS146 cut -> BS164 recover -> sprint
BS166 backpedal -> BS169 hip flip -> BS171 pursuit -> BS176 prepare -> BS108/BS109 swat
